Recorded claim:
`enterprise.prompt_on_signout` is inherited behavior, not D290877: `all-thunderbird.js` sets it true under `MOZ_ENTERPRISE`; `EnterpriseHandler` defaults true, suppresses prompt when false, and persists the checkbox after confirmation. [Task 1]
